captions.text: Coere saves your chats from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and six more AIs.
Onboarding asks which AIs Maya uses. She picks ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
Extract all opens each AI in the background and saves every chat, with a row for each.
Every chat is saved, on this computer only.
Later, Maya has new chats. When she opens an AI, Coere saves them by itself.
Home counts what is saved, and Recently saved leads with the newest chats.
Memory says her DATA 100 lab is due Aug 18, from a chat on Claude.
Today she went back to that chat and said the lab moved to Aug 22.
Coere saved the changed chat and read it again. Memory now says Aug 22.
The old date stays under Earlier, with the message that moved it.
The Library keeps every chat from every AI, to search, read, download or move to another AI.
Saving chats needs no AI and no account.
